phase_order: Validate and implement historical shadow supervision and joint latent risk
Freeze all feature definitions, selected views and fold tables
24h model-only campaign on available lab CPUs and GPUs
Freeze within-fold recipe, evaluate and if stable gain plan refit
clock_policy: Clock starts after FEATURE_FREEZE passes and the model-only gate is admitted; research and feature preparation reported separately. Absolute deadline saved once in CLOCK.json and never reset.
data_source: Supplied competition tables; external research only motivates methods.
protocol: Original stratified5fold70k,50kcontext6000correction14000outer per fold; all learned representations fit onlycontext and historicalloan training borrowers excluded from their query predictions.
evaluation: tie-aware pooled two-sample KS on class1 probability, AUC reported. All70kouter labels previously exposed; independent audit unavailable.
feature_policy: Immutable master116, exact count measured by freeze. Fixed declared views champion90,shadow91,latent99,full100,master. No additions/removals/value regeneration for search. Model preprocessing fitted on context is permitted; context routing never adds source features.
teacher: 3 customer folds within50kcontext plusfullcontextteacher forcorrection/outer. NeuralWeibull interval likelihood35epochs;CatBoost400iterations onknown12labels. No exact90DPD event reconstruction.
joint_latent: Fixed4view productofexperts VAE8latent; reconstruction+KL.005+historicalBCE.25+currentBCE.25,40epochs. Contextlabels only. Same frozenvalues for all model seeds.

model_selection.ranking_choice: Stratified half of6000correction ranksmodels;otherhalfchoosesmixture,seed261026. Treesearlystoprankinghalf only. Rankingstudenttrainrankinghalf only.
model_selection.ties: Prefer smaller weight and smaller ensemble.
model_selection.selection_records: Freeze eachfoldrecipe and source/config/feature hashes before loading outerlabels.
model_selection.individual_diagnostics: Fullfamily ablative scores at terminal reporting only, no live outerselection.

promotion: Target separatefromgeneralization. Requirepositivepooledgain,pairedstratifiedbootstrap95%interval>0,atleast3positivefolddeltas and samegain direction onsecondseed whereapplicable. Freeze featuretable neverchanges for repeats.
resources: All available lab resources: nodes2001,2002,2003; up to6 idle GPU slots plus up to5CPU fits perhost (2threads each), reduced by two reserved hostthreads and two threads for each busyGPU, including other workloads. CPU+GPU quotas stay within this allowance. A100excluded perusermove.
storage: Only actual userhome on eachhost. Immutable featurepackets compactcopy. No fitted weights/checkpoints or KV caches; sharedoriginalpretrainedcheckpoints reused. Recipes, params,seeds, source hashes andpredictions retained.
incomplete_policy: Failed fits retained; completedfivefoldconfigs alone qualify forselection. No targetclaim ifunfinished.
